name: Afterimage
description: a pale see-through ghostly copy of an armoured knight in plate armour with a closed helm, glowing faint blue-white, wisps of mist trailing off it, empty hands

idle.action: stands, flickering faintly, mist curling off it

move.action: walks steadily forward, a faint blue-white trail behind it, staying in the same spot in the frame

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
